name: capell-app/widget-slideshow
description: Slideshow block for Capell pages with up to twenty captioned photos, optional links and opt-in autoplay.

marketplace.summary: Give a job, an event or a product its own slideshow in one spot on the page, with captions and links, for visitors to step through.
marketplace.description: Add a Slideshow block to a page in Layout Builder and fill it with one to twenty photos you upload to the block. Each slide needs a description of the image and can carry a caption and a link. Autoplay is optional, advances every five seconds and has a Pause button. The block takes its name from a label that screen readers read out. Without JavaScript, visitors see only the first slide.
marketplace.problem: I have a dozen photos of one job, and stacked down the page they push everything else out of sight.
marketplace.outcome: A job's photos share one spot on the page, and visitors move through them at their own pace.

faq.question: Can visitors pause the slideshow?
faq.answer: Yes, when you have ticked Advance automatically. A Pause button then sits between Previous and Next, and the slides also hold still while a pointer or keyboard focus is on them. Devices that ask for reduced motion begin with it paused and a Resume button.

faq.question: Does it move on by itself?
faq.answer: Only if you tick Advance automatically, and then it moves on every five seconds.

faq.question: Which images can I use?
faq.answer: Ones you have uploaded to your own site. Images from other websites are rejected, and each slide needs a short description.

faq.question: How many slides can one slideshow hold?
faq.answer: Up to twenty. On the last slide, Next takes a visitor back to the first.

faq.question: Can a slide link somewhere?
faq.answer: Yes. A slide can have a link, but its label and address both have to be filled in.
